mainSubtitle: Send your message to the screen!
blacklistBlocked: This content is blocked by the blacklist.
bannerBlocked: ⚠ Message contains a blocked word · masked by admin
hintBlocked: ⚠ Contains blocked word · masked by admin
overlayOfflineFire: The screen isn't up yet · messages can't be sent right now
adminSubtitle: Tune the live experience, moderate incoming messages, and manage assets without hunting through one long page.
navShortcutsHint: Shortcuts are grouped by what you are trying to do right now.
sectionLiveControlDesc: These controls define how messages look, move, and feel during the stream.
sectionModerationDesc: Keep the live stream healthy with history, filtering, blacklists, and quick reaction tools.
sectionAssetsDesc: Manage themes, sounds, stickers, emojis, widgets, and other reusable building blocks.
assetMediaLibraryDesc: Keep the frequently reused pieces close instead of burying them in a long maintenance list.
assetVisualSystemDesc: Tune the overall atmosphere here before going deeper into lower-level sections.
assetExtensionsDesc: Treat integrations as a separate lane so the dashboard reads like operations, not a toolbox dump.
sectionAutomationDesc: Webhooks, scheduled messages, and other higher-leverage workflows.
themesSectionDesc: Predefined visual themes for danmu styles and effects
pollSectionDesc: Create interactive polls for viewers to vote via danmu
sidebarWorkflowCopy: Treat this page as a control tower: tune the stream on the left, then jump directly to moderation or asset sections from here.
sidebarRecommendedCopy: For live tuning, adjust style, verify output in live feed, then move to history and filters only if moderation is needed.
fontSizeSettingDesc: Allow users to customize font size
fontFamilyDescEnabled: Users can choose their font. Select the default font here if they don't choose, or the font to be used if user choice is disabled.
fontFamilyDescDisabled: Users cannot choose their font. Danmus will use the font selected below.
fontForDanmus: Font for Danmus / Default User Choice
fontUploadHint: Uploaded fonts become available in the selection above and for users (if enabled).
selectTTFFile: Please select a TTF file to upload.
invalidFileType: Invalid file type. Only TTF files are allowed.
fontUploadError: An error occurred during font upload.
layoutDescEnabled: Users can choose the danmu layout mode. The default mode selected here will be used when users don't specify one.
layoutDescDisabled: Users cannot choose the layout mode. All danmu will use the mode selected below.
effectsSettingDesc: Allow users to apply visual effects (animations) to danmu
effectsEnabledMsg: Effects are enabled. Users can apply animations to their danmu messages.
effectsDisabledMsg: Effects are disabled. All danmu will display without animations.
blacklistManagementDesc: Add or remove keywords from the blacklist.
danmuHistoryDesc: View and search sent danmu messages.
blockTitle: Add this text to the blacklist
confirmClearHistory: Are you sure you want to clear all danmu history? This action cannot be undone.
wsAuthDesc: Require a shared token for Electron Desktop clients.
wsAuthRequireHint: Recommended ON when the web port is reachable beyond your LAN. New clients must include ?token=... in the WS URL.
wsAuthTokenHint: 12–128 chars. Paste this into your Electron client's WS Token field.
wsAuthCopyFailed: Copy failed — select the field and copy manually.
wsAuthTokenRequired: Token is required when 'Require token' is on.
wsAuthSaveFailed: Failed to save WS auth settings.
onscreenLimitsDesc: Cap concurrent onscreen danmu; overflow either drops or queues.
onscreenMaxHint: 0–200. Set 0 to disable the cap. Default 20.
onscreenModeHint: Queue mode holds overflow and releases each slot as earlier danmu finish animating.
onscreenSaveFailed: Failed to save traffic control settings.
onscreenInvalidRange: Max onscreen danmu must be between 0 and 200.
onscreenFullQueued: Screen is full — you're in the queue…
onscreenFullDropped: Screen is full — try again in a moment.
queueFullTryLater: Queue is full — please try again in a minute.
broadcastStandbyQueued: Desktop paused receiving — your danmu is queued and will appear when it resumes.
colorFormatError: Color format error, please use #RRGGBB format
emojiStickersDesc: Upload and manage custom emojis for danmu
emojiUsageHint: Type :emoji_name: in your danmu to use emojis
emojiNameInvalid: Name must be alphanumeric/underscore, max 32 chars
emojiInvalidFileType: Only PNG, GIF, and WebP files are allowed
stickersDesc: Upload sticker images that viewers trigger with :sticker_name:
stickerUsageHint: Viewers send :sticker_name: as the full message to display a sticker. Supported formats: GIF, PNG, WebP. Max 2 MB per file.
fontsDesc: Manage uploaded .ttf fonts available to viewers
soundEffectsDesc: Upload sounds and configure trigger rules
noEffectsLoaded: No effects loaded. Upload a .dme file to add effects.
webhooksDesc: Send event notifications to external services
filterRulesDesc: Content filtering rules for danmu messages
pluginsHint: Place .py plugin files in server/plugins/ directory
schedulerDesc: Automatically send messages on a timer
theme_neon_desc: Neon glow effect with cyberpunk style
theme_retro_desc: Retro pixel style with blink effect
widgetsDesc: Add scoreboards, tickers, and labels to the OBS Desktop
widgetClearConfirm: Remove all widgets from the Desktop?
streamModeHelp: Hide low-frequency sections while live (themes, sounds, plugins, etc.) Preference saved locally.
fingerprintsDesc: Live view of client fingerprints — msg count, rate, and block history. In-memory, cleared on restart.
fingerprintResetConfirm: Clear all fingerprint records? This cannot be undone.
offlineMessage: Event has not started, or the host is offline.
offlineHint: Please wait and try again shortly.
displayAdminControlledNote: Viewers cannot switch languages. The page follows the browser language by default; admins can force a language in Viewer Page Theme.
modbansHint: ⚠ Timed bans auto-lift on expiry · permanent bans need manual unban
modbansConfirmPermBody: Permanently ban {target}. Only manual unban afterwards.
modbansPageNote: Unified view of timed / permanent bans. Source of truth = audit log; list state = each target's latest event. Expiry is lazy-checked client-side (no reaper thread).
backupPageNote: Export history/settings, restore backups, and the danger-zone actions live here — for a full system reset, manually delete server/runtime/.
backupSettingsSnapshotDesc: One-click JSON snapshot (assembled client-side). Password hashes and tokens are automatically stripped.
backupPackAssetHint: For uploaded assets, use ASSET PACK below instead — this keeps large media from slowing down the regular settings snapshot.
backupApplyDisabledTitle: Run dry-run preview first before applying
backupSettingsRestoreNote: Dry-run first to check the diff against current settings; applying overwrites matching setting rows and syncs Desktop / viewer instantly.
backupFullPackRestoreNote: Dry-run first to confirm the manifest and which files will be overwritten; applying atomically overwrites runtime/ · effects/ · plugins/ · user_plugins/ file by file.
backupRestoreBeforeApplyHint: We recommend downloading a current snapshot before applying, as a fallback for recovery.
backupAssetRestoreNote: Only writes to emojis/ · stickers/ · sounds/ · runtime/stickers/packs.json; once applied, the asset cache used by Desktop / viewer is refreshed.
backupClearHistoryDesc: Clear all danmu history. This action cannot be undone.
backupFactoryResetDesc: Resets runtime state files and in-memory queues; does not remove the login password, effect files, plugins, or uploaded assets.
backupSelectJsonFirst: Please select a JSON file first
backupSettingsMustBeObject: settings must be a JSON object
backupApplySettingsConfirmBody: Settings in the snapshot with matching names will overwrite the current values; settings not included in the snapshot remain unchanged.
backupClearHistoryConfirmBody: All archived danmu records will be deleted and cannot be recovered. We recommend downloading a full snapshot first.
backupFactoryResetConfirmBody: runtime state files and the current queue will all be cleared, with no way to undo it. If you haven't downloaded a full snapshot yet, there's still time to cancel.
backupApplyFullPackConfirmBody: This will overwrite your current runtime/, effects/, plugins/, and user_plugins/. Have you already downloaded a current snapshot as a recovery fallback?
backupPackAppliedRestartHint: Applied {n} files · restart the service to reload .dme / plugins
backupSelectAssetTarGzFirst: Please select an asset .tar.gz file first
backupAssetDryRunPassedCount: Asset Dry-run passed · {n} files pending write
backupApplyAssetPackConfirmBody: Files with matching names under emojis/, stickers/, sounds/, and sticker pack metadata will be overwritten.
displayViewerDefaultsKicker: Each row sets the submit default + whether the audience can customize it
displayViewerDefaultsNote: Display controls the Desktop / client / target display / idle QR; Viewer is where you set /fire submit defaults, fields and copy.
displayHintAudienceOn: Starting value when the audience drags the slider
displayAutoSyncNote: Changes push instantly — Desktop now, viewers on next refresh
displayFieldsTip: · Hidden fields still submit their defaults; outline / shadow isn't a per-message field — Theme Packs control it globally.
displayFieldNicknameDesc: Single-line input; shown as the author name
displayFieldStyleBoundaryDesc: Outline / shadow are controlled globally by Theme Packs
displayMsgLenHint: CJK / latin / emoji each count as 1
displayDedupHint: Same fingerprint · same content · silently dropped
displayRateFpHint: Over the cap queues · 1 min cooldown
displayRateLimitsFooter: Changes apply instantly · danmu already on Desktop are unaffected
displayViewerConfigInfoBanner: Viewer manages the audience page: Viewer Page Theme controls the overall look of /fire (background, tabs, text color); Form Fields controls the inputs the audience sees on the send form (nickname / color / size / speed / layout / effect). Theme styling is managed globally by Theme Packs.
helpDrawerDefaultTip2: ⌘K opens global command search; Esc closes modal / drawer
helpDrawerDefaultTip3: Click any top KPI number to jump to its page
helpDrawerLiveTip1: The KPI bar above shows live session stats
helpDrawerLiveTip2: Right column Quick Actions: F1-F4 map to Effects / Poll / Blacklist / Desktop
helpDrawerLiveTip3: Click any KPI number to jump to its page
helpDrawerPollsTip1: pending → active → ended; new polls start as pending
helpDrawerPollsTip2: While active, the audience votes by typing A/B/C/D (case-insensitive)
helpDrawerPollsTip3: Multi-question polls: finishing one question auto-advances to the next
helpDrawerPollsTip4: polestar lock: the audience view never shows vote counts / percentages
helpDrawerWidgetsTip1: Enabled widgets render on top of the OBS / Electron Desktop layer
helpDrawerWidgetsTip2: Scoreboard / ticker / label can all be enabled at once; order follows layer
helpDrawerWidgetsTip3: The OBS browser source URL can be copied with one click at the top of the page
helpDrawerModerationTip1: Quick Filters chips are temporary rules that auto-expire when the session ends
helpDrawerModerationTip2: The blacklist holds long-term rules that persist across sessions
helpDrawerModerationTip4: Messages matching review enter the moderation queue; unhandled after 30s auto-rejects
helpDrawerWebhooksTip1: The ↻ Test button beside each endpoint sends one ping
helpDrawerWebhooksTip3: HMAC-SHA256 signing uses the X-Webhook-Signature header
helpDrawerApiTokensTip1: The token is shown only once at creation — copy and save it immediately
helpDrawerApiTokensTip2: admin:* scope grants full admin privileges — recommended for CI/CD use only
helpDrawerApiTokensTip3: Tokens unused for 90 days are auto-flagged as inactive
helpDrawerPluginsTip1: Plugins are server-side code (.py/.js) with full system access
helpDrawerPluginsTip2: Lower Priority values run first — CRITICAL (≤10) beats HIGH (≤50)
helpDrawerPluginsTip3: Hot-reload doesn't interrupt messages currently being processed
helpDrawerOverlayTip1: ▶ Start display / ■ Stop display toggles rendering
helpDrawerOverlayTip2: ◐ Pause display: the session keeps running but Desktop freezes; resuming drains the queue
helpDrawerOverlayTip3: ⊗ Clear screen: wipes danmu currently on Desktop (fires the on_overlay_clear webhook)
helpDrawerViewerTip1: 4 tabs: Page (page-wide theme) / Fields (form fields) / Defaults (submit defaults) / Limits (limits)
helpDrawerViewerTip2: The Defaults tab lets you open each parameter to audience customization individually
helpDrawerViewerTip3: The Limits tab shows rate / dedup / content length — edit at #/ratelimit
helpDrawerModqueueTip1: PENDING amber: waiting on a 30-second admin countdown
helpDrawerModqueueTip2: APPROVED lime: pushed to Desktop once approved
helpDrawerModqueueTip3: REJECTED crimson: discarded; AUTO-REJECTED means the countdown ran out
helpDrawerModqueueTip4: Messages matching a filter rule set to action=review land on this page automatically
helpDrawerSessionsTip1: A session = a time slice (messages / polls / stats) — not a "livestream"
helpDrawerSessionsTip2: Turning Desktop on auto-starts a new session; turning Desktop off ≠ ending the session
helpDrawerSessionsTip3: Only "End & Archive" files the slice into history (read-only)
helpDrawerSystemTip1: Overview: metric tiles + service status + recent errors
helpDrawerSystemTip2: Security: password / WS token / IP allowlist
helpDrawerSystemTip3: Backup: export archived sessions as JSON / CSV
helpDrawerSystemTip4: Restart WS / Force GC are disabled (for safety)
helpDrawerShortcutLiveFeed: Switch to the live message feed
helpDrawerGlossaryDesktopDef: The danmu display layer in Electron / OBS — not the viewer page
helpDrawerGlossarySessionDef: The data scope of a time slice — not a user session
helpDrawerGlossaryFireTokenDef: The shared auth key for the Extension — separate from API Tokens
helpDrawerGlossaryFingerprintDef: Anonymous identification based on browser characteristics — no login required
helpDrawerGlossaryDmeDef: Danmu Effect format — a CSS animation bundle defined in YAML
pollBuilderPageKicker: Multi-question · drag to reorder · image upload per question
pollBuilderPageNote: Build a multi-question poll; viewers submit by tapping an option — vote counts and percentages are visible to admins only.
pollBuilderCropApplyNote: Applies to all option images in this question
pollBuilderOptionsFieldLabel: Options · 2–6 · drag ⋮⋮ to reorder · images optional per option
pollBuilderRemoveQConfirmBody: Remove this question from the draft. Already-started polls are unaffected.
pollBuilderToastNeedSession: Press START SESSION to create the poll before uploading images
pollBuilderToastNotSynced: This question hasn't synced to the server yet
pollBuilderErrNoQuestions: Add at least one question first
security2PageNote: Single-admin mode · no role separation. The left border color of each card below indicates status: lime = ready, cyan = in progress, amber = warning, crimson = danger.
security2WsTokenToggleLabel: Require token auth (Desktop connections must include a token)
security2IpToggleLabel: Only allow the IP / CIDR entries below to access admin
security2CorsCredentialsToggleLabel: Allow credentials (cannot be combined with a wildcard origin)
security2TlsRecommendationNote: We recommend enabling TLS at the reverse proxy layer (nginx / Caddy).
security2AuditLogNote: Every admin action (login / password change / token rotation / plugin upload / Desktop clear / etc.) is automatically written to the audit log, which can be queried and exported at #/audit.
security2ToastPasswordMinLength: New password must be at least 8 characters
security2ToastPasswordMismatch: The two new password entries do not match
security2IpStatusDisabled: Disabled — all IPs can access admin
security2ToastTokenRequiredWhenEnabled: A token is required when enabled
security2RotateConfirmBody: The old token is invalidated immediately — Desktop must reconnect using the new token.
security2ConfirmRevokeApiTokens: Revoke all API tokens? All external integrations will stop working immediately.
security2ConfirmRevokeFireToken: Revoke Fire Token? All extensions will need to be reconfigured.
security2ConfirmResetWsToken: Reset WS Token? Desktop will need to use the new token when reconnecting.
webhooksPageNote: Centrally manage external notification endpoints. Signed with HMAC-SHA256 (X-Webhook-Signature). Events fire-and-forget with up to N retries (exponential backoff 1s/2s/4s).
webhooksEmptyDesc: Forward danmu live to Discord / Slack / a custom endpoint, or receive danmu from an external service.
apiTokensPageNote: Issue scope-limited tokens for external integrations, CI/CD, or extensions. The token is shown only once after creation.
apiTokensSuccessNote: Copy and save it immediately. It cannot be viewed again after you leave.
apiTokensOnceWarnNote: ⚠ The token is shown only once after creation — copy and save it immediately.
apiTokensRevokeBody: Integrations using this token will immediately lose access.
apiTokensEmptyDesc: Use the form on the right to issue your first token.
apiTokensErrNeedLabel: Please fill in the token name (LABEL)
apiTokensErrNeedScope: Please select at least one scope
audiencePageNote: Fingerprint aggregation of connected viewers, sorted by message_count. Source: fingerprint_tracker (in-memory).
audienceRuleSameIp: {n} fingerprints on same IP · device switch / VPN likely
audienceRuleBridge: Slido / extension bridge · messages via fire token
audienceDetailNoMsgs: No messages in the last 5 min
audienceKickPrompt: Kick fingerprint fp:{fp} — enter a reason (optional)
audienceUnkickBody: This fingerprint will be able to send danmu again. {fpHtml}
audienceToastNoRules: No filter rules on this fingerprint
audienceBanBody: Messages from this fingerprint will be auto-masked for this session. {fpHtml}
emptySessionsDesc: Start your first session and its record will appear here. Audience count, messages and poll history are kept per session.
emptyPollsDesc: Create your first poll — the audience joins live by typing option codes (A/B/C/D). Single, multiple and timed modes supported.
emptyAudienceDesc: When viewers open the link or scan the QR code, their fingerprints show up here. No connections yet.
emptyEventsDesc: The system event stream is empty — no errors, no warnings. WebSocket connects, plugin errors and scheduler triggers get logged here.
emptyMessagesDesc: Once the session starts, audience messages appear here live. Make sure Desktop is on (Live → start display).
emptyBlacklistDesc: No fingerprints or IPs banned yet. Ban a user from the live feed or add a rule manually and it shows up here.
emptyFiltersDesc: Live filters are temporary and expire when the session ends. Turn on Quick Filters or write a custom regex to catch bad messages.
emptySchedulerDesc: Stage your demo flow ahead of time — no scrambling mid-event. Cron, one-shot and recurring schedules can fire polls, push messages and switch themes.
viewerThemePageNote: Only affects the page appearance viewers see when entering /fire; the danmu's own color / outline / shadow is managed by Theme Packs, and Desktop layout & connection live under "Desktop Control".
viewerThemePreviewModeKickerNote: Preview on this card only, doesn't affect viewers
viewerThemeForceBoundaryNote: When viewers open /fire, the theme follows prefers-color-scheme and the language follows navigator.language; the top-right corner no longer shows a theme toggle or language dropdown. To force a unified look (e.g. a conference that wants uniform dark mode for projection), configure it here.
viewerThemeLogoDropHint: Drop a PNG · or click to choose
viewerThemeComposerPlaceholder: Got something to say to the room?
firetokenPageNote: The shared secret the extension uses over the /fire channel. This page shows usage trends, recent source IPs, and token lifecycle events. Single token, operator-managed; per-integration ACL goes through {link}.
firetokenCurlMeta: X-Fire-Source drives the catalog status light
firetokenRotationTip1: Rotate at least once every 90 days.
firetokenRotationTip2: Update the new token in the extension popup first, then click "Regenerate".
firetokenRegenModalBody: Every extension currently using the old Token will immediately lose access and need to be reconfigured with the new Token.
firetokenRevokeModalBody: Every extension will stop working immediately until you generate a new Token and reconfigure them.
firetokenNotSetHint: Not set — click "Regenerate" to create one
firetokenNoChartData: No data yet (within 24h of server start)
sessionDetailPageNote: Drill into a single data slice: density timeline, message-by-message list, poll stats. Read-only content (fixed once the session ends).
sessionDetailPlaybackNote: ← Actual playback is available on the History page
sessionDetailAnnEmptyDesc: Hover anywhere on the timeline · click + to add.
sessionDetailNotePlaceholder: Audience laugh moment, poll reveal, key Q&A…
sessionDetailErrNoSessionSelected: Please select a session from the session list
broadcastPageNote: Turn Desktop / OBS danmu display on or off; start and end a session from "Dashboard".
broadcastConfirmHint: A confirmation appears before stopping display · after Desktop stops, messages keep arriving but aren't rendered
broadcastBigResume: ▶ Resume display · queued messages will play
broadcastToastPaused: Paused display · messages will be queued
broadcastStopBodyDesc: Desktop will stop rendering danmu. Messages will keep arriving and be recorded into the session.
broadcastStopBodyWarn: ⚠ Session data is unaffected · you can restart display anytime
broadcastClearModalBody: Only clears the danmu currently shown on Desktop; archived message records are unaffected.
setupWizardThemeDefaultDesc: Standard white danmu, suited to most stream layouts.
setupWizardThemeNeonDesc: High-contrast glowing colors, suited to dark backgrounds and stage lighting.
setupWizardThemeRetroDesc: Warm tones with a pixel-art feel, suited to event key visuals.
setupWizardThemeCinemaDesc: Low-saturation gold with a subtitle feel, suited to launches and forums.
setupWizardDisplayDedupeDesc: Merges identical content sent in a short window into a single track, keeping the screen from being flooded.
setupWizardDisplayPreviewDesc: Images show as thumbnails first, so they don't immediately take over the whole screen.
setupWizardDisplayMaxLengthDesc: Messages over 120 characters collapse first — tap to expand and read the full content.
setupWizardModSensitiveDesc: Enables the built-in blocked-word list to filter out common violations up front.
setupWizardModRateLimitDesc: Caps messages at 20 per minute, lowering the risk of bots or flooding.
setupWizardModFingerprintDesc: Automatically identifies repeat users, making later blocking and tracing easier.
setupWizardServerDesc: The v5 design condenses the first step into a snapshot of the current deployment — confirm the public entry point and same-origin WS path are correct before moving on to display and moderation settings.
setupWizardDisplayDesc: This page maps to the Display Rules in the v5 handoff. Pick the default pacing for the output screen here, then fine-tune details on the individual viewer / Desktop pages later.
setupWizardModerationDesc: The third step of the Yellow draft is the moderation baseline. These toggles currently serve as suggested startup values, reminding you to turn on the basic defenses on first deployment.
setupWizardThemeDesc: This step applies directly through the existing theme API. Pick a starting style here, then fine-tune fonts, colors, and effects later on the "Theme Packs" page.
setupWizardDoneDesc: Everything is ready. You can always come back to each page for further adjustments — this wizard is only responsible for aligning the v5 starting configuration.
notifPageNote: Aggregates every alert source (rate limits / Fire Token events / sensitive-word triggers). Read / archived state lives in browser localStorage.
notifExplainBody: ℹ Notifications ≠ {link}. Notifications = messages that need admin attention / action (warn-tier+ fire token revocations, moderation drops, webhook failures); Events = the full automated log (including every info-tier change).
notifTipBody: Notification retention is decided by each backend service (rate limits: 30 entries, fire token audit: 100 entries, filters log: live fetch, audit.log: recent events). Read / archived state is local to the browser.
notifEmptyTitle: No notifications match the current filters
notifEmptyDesc: New events (rate limits / token / moderation / webhooks / system) will show up here automatically.
msgDrawerBanWarn: ⚠ All messages from this fingerprint will be masked, and the fingerprint will be added to the blacklist.
msgDrawerBlacklistKwBody: Messages containing this text will be blocked from now on.
pluginsUploadErrorMulti: Only one file can be uploaded at a time
pluginsUploadDropzoneMsg: Drop a .py or .js file here · or click to browse
pluginsUploadDropzoneHint: Max 256 KB · single file · Python (.py) or JavaScript (.js)
pluginsUploadNoManifestBody: Add this comment block at the top of the file so admin can identify the plugin's metadata:
pluginsUploadNoManifestAck: Confirm installing without a manifest (priority=100, no description)
pluginsUploadDupWarning: ⚠ A plugin with this name already exists · installing will overwrite {name}
pluginsUploadNoPermsDeclared: No permissions declared · treated as read-only
pluginsUploadConfirmHint: Plugins are server-side code · enabled automatically after installing
pluginsUploadStepHotReload: Hot-reload the plugin system (no restart required)
pluginsUploadDontClose: Please do not close this window
cmdkClearHistoryBody: All archived message records will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
cmdkSearchPlaceholder: Search messages · users · settings · routes · themes · actions...
cmdkFooterNote: All actions run on the Server · Desktop Client only displays danmu
wcagPageNote: Verify danmu colors meet WCAG AA / AAA standards against various backgrounds. When viewers pick their own color, the system automatically rejects combinations that fail AA.
wcagGuardrailNote: When viewers pick their own color, the system automatically rejects combinations that fail AA and suggests an alternative.
wcagWarnFail: Fails AA · suggest adjusting foreground brightness +10~15%
wcagWarnLargeOnly: Only large text passes AA · small text fails
wcagPairAriaLabel: {name} — contrast {ratio} to 1, {level}. Load into single-pair tester
pollDeepdivePageNote: Option distribution, vote share, and integrity checks.
pollDeepdiveEmptyDesc: Create or start a poll, then come back here for the deep-dive.
pollDeepdiveNoOptions: This poll doesn't have any options yet.
pollDeepdiveTimelinePlaceholderDesc: The poll service currently only records the voter set, not a per-vote timestamp. Building a time histogram requires writing each vote's ts into SQLite / an append-only log first. Already noted in {link}.
pollDeepdiveGeoPlaceholderDesc: v5.2 fire_sources collects the IP but doesn't do a GeoIP lookup. v5.3 wants to add MaxMind / ipinfo lite to produce a country breakdown.
pollDeepdiveIntegrityBotSub: UA / timing analysis not implemented yet
sessionsPageNote: A session = a time window (including messages / polls / stats). Turning Desktop on is the trigger, but a session's real role is a "data slice" — once it ends, it's archived to history. Click to view detailed stats, or open the full analytics page.
aboutPageNote: Open-source danmu interaction system — server (Flask) + desktop (Electron) + viewer (web).
aboutToastNoClipboard: This browser doesn't support the clipboard API
extSlidoDesc: Chrome extension that automatically pushes questions from Slido into the danmu feed.
extDiscordDesc: Bridges Discord channel messages into danmu (with reaction filtering).
extObsDesc: OBS Studio Lua script that sends hotkey-triggered danmu to the server.
extBookmarkletDesc: Browser bookmark that opens the viewer in one click, with nickname / color pre-filled.
extSlidoStepConfig: In your Slido workspace, click the Danmu icon → paste the Fire Token
extTokenHint: Paste the token into the extension's popup settings. Revoking immediately disables every extension (just paste the new one after regenerating).
extPageNote: Centralized management of extensions and bot integrations. Slido extension / Discord bridge / OBS plugin / bookmarklet all share the same {tag}, a separate lane from admin's API Tokens (per-integration ACL).
extToastTokenGenerated: Fire Token generated · copied to clipboard
extTokenPrefixHint: {prefix} (only the first 6 characters are shown; the full value is visible only right after generation)
extTokenNotSetHint: Not set — click "Generate" to create a token
ratelimitPageNote: The maximum number of requests each source IP (or fingerprint) may send within a time window. Click "Apply Now" to take effect immediately without a restart; to persist across restarts, use "Export .env Snippet" below to write it back to the config file.
ratelimitLockoutFieldTitle: Seconds locked out after trigger · UI-only · backend support coming soon
ratelimitApplyBtnTitle: Apply immediately to the running server (reverts to env defaults on restart)
ratelimitIpHelp: Allowlist takes priority over denylist · supports IPv4/IPv6 · a single IP auto-converts to /32 or /128
ratelimitIpRequiredError: Please enter an IP or CIDR
ratelimitIpFormatError: This doesn't look like a valid IP/CIDR
fontsPageNote: Upload fonts for viewers to choose from (WOFF2 / OTF / TTF); use subset to shrink large font files down to the character range you actually need.
fontsDropTitle: Drag and drop or click to select a file
fontsDropHint: Max 5 MB · client validates magic bytes
fontsPreviewLatin: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
fontsPreviewCJK: 永 和 安 康 繁 體 中 文 測 試
fontsSubsetAutoDesc: Automatically generates a subset, loading only the characters actually used
fontsEmptyDesc: Defaults to Noto Sans TC + IBM Plex Mono. Upload .woff2 / .ttf to offer viewers a choice, or set one as the Desktop default font.
fontsSubsetBtnTitle: Reduce font size · keep only the specified character range
fontsRowSample: 啊 永 の A a 123
fontsSubsetWarn: ⚠ Subsetting overwrites the original file in place · cannot be undone · characters outside the range will not display
fontsToastNeedPresetOrRange: Please select at least one preset or enter a custom range
fontsToastMissingFontTools: Backend is missing fontTools — run `uv add fonttools`
fontsExtNotSupportedFull: Unsupported file extension. Only .TTF / .OTF / .WOFF2 are allowed.
fontsFileTooLargeFull: File size exceeds 5 MB. Please compress it or use a smaller font file.
fontsInvalidFontToast: File is not a valid font
fontsMagicInvalid: Invalid magic bytes — file is not a valid font
fontsMagicValidationFailed: Magic bytes validation failed. The file content is not a valid font.
fontsUploadFailedRetry: Upload failed. Please try again later.
fontsNetworkDisconnected: Network connection lost. Please check and try again.
modqueueEmptyDesc: All pending messages handled. New filtered messages will show up here automatically.
modqueueHintLine: ℹ Messages flagged "pending" in the Live Feed land here automatically · click a FLAG row in the Live Feed to jump here
modqueueBulkApproveBody: Every pending LOW-severity message in the queue will be released.
modqueueBulkRejectBody: Every pending HIGH-severity message in the queue will be rejected.
fxDeleteWarn: This can't be undone; historical messages using this effect fall back to the default style.
fxHintFlashBlock: Rate > 4× may trigger photosensitive seizures — blocked per WCAG 2.1 SC 2.3.1
fxHintFlashWarn: Rate > 3× nears the WCAG 2.1 SC 2.3.1 warning threshold
fxHintAmpBlock: Amplitude > 30px may drop frames on low-end devices — keep ≤ 24px
fxHintAmpWarn: Amplitude > 24px may hurt performance — consider easing it

obStep1Body: This page shows the running session at a glance — audience count, message stream, polls, health. Everything important is above the fold.
obStep2Body: Press ⌘K anytime — search messages, jump to any page, run quick actions. Master it and skip 3/4 of your clicks.
obStep3Body: Hooking up Slido, OBS or your own bot? Grab a Fire Token on the Integrations page — any tool can POST messages into your session.
obStep4Body: Webhook failures, quota nearing the cap, backup errors — they all land here. Worth checking once a day.
obStep5Body: You can replay this tour anytime from the About page. Try starting a test session and watch audience messages fly.
